_review.description: Mainnet entries MUST be reviewed and approved before merge. Any change to a mainnet address requires an explicit review marker (see _review.mainnetApproval) and a corresponding entry in _review.mainnetApprovals. Unreviewed or silently changed mainnet addresses fail closed in CI and in the bindings addresses loader.

errorCodes.MAINNET_ADDRESS_UNREVIEWED: Mainnet address change lacks required review approval marker.
errorCodes.MAINNET_ADDRESS_MISMATCH: Mainnet address does not match the approved value recorded in _review.mainnetApprovals.
errorCodes.MAINNET_APPROVAL_MISSING: No approval record found for the given mainnet address key.
